units.source_text: 然而，这是非同寻常的局面。

en.t: However, this was an extraordinary situation.

units.source_text: 午休时刻，不知是我们自然而然地跟着名人走，还是名人有意地邀请我们去，回到名人的房间，

en.t: At lunchtime, whether we naturally followed the master or the master deliberately invited us, we returned to his room,

units.source_text: 刚要落座，名人就对我们说：

en.t: Just as we were about to sit down, the master said to us:
